changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Create finances.holding_daily_snapshots, the end-of-day price and value of every active holding (issue #554). The Overview compares today's price with the one at the start of the month to find the month's best and worst holding. Figures are stored in the wallet's own currency, like finances.wallet_daily_snapshots.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE finances.holding_daily_snapshots ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE, kind finances.wallet_kind NOT NULL, holding_id BIGINT NOT NULL, wallet_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES finances.wallets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, snapshot_date DATE NOT NULL, current_price NUMERIC, current_value NUMERIC, cost_basis NUMERIC NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE (kind, holding_id, snapshot_date) );
